question_cn: 马兵对王，升变格附近马的特点是：
question_en: Knight and pawn vs. king — what is the key characteristic of the knight near the promotion square?

options.text_cn: 马能控制所有颜色的格子，胜率高
options.text_en: Knight controls all colors, high winning rate

options.text_cn: 马在角落附近活动能力弱，有时无法阻止对方王守角
options.text_en: Knight is weak near corners and may not stop the enemy king from defending

options.text_cn: 马不需要王的配合就能推兵升变
options.text_en: Knight can push the pawn to promote without king help

options.text_cn: 马比象更容易实现升变
options.text_en: Knight promotes more easily than bishop

explanation_cn: 马兵残局的元思维：马在开阔位置强，但在角落附近活动格少（马的弱点）。边路兵+马有时因马无法覆盖关键格而成和局，这是重要的例外识别。
explanation_en: Meta-concept: knight is strong in open positions but weak near corners (fewer squares to jump to). Knight + rook pawn can sometimes draw due to coverage gaps.
